name: Inline
layerWhy: It arranges other parts by space; it keeps no promise to the person of its own.
promise: Things side by side, wrapping when room runs out.
expectation: A row aligned on its middles.
evidence: It wraps instead of overflowing; .pr-push sends one to the end.
context: Name and badge, a row of metadata, a row of buttons.
relationships: .pr-push puts the last thing at the end.
